name: AML & Financial Crime Compliance
description: Transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, KYC, and suspicious activity reporting.

metrics.name: alerts_generated
metrics.description: Monitoring alerts generated in the period

metrics.name: alert_to_case_rate
metrics.description: Alerts escalated to cases divided by alerts

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Alerts closed without escalation divided by alerts

metrics.name: sars_filed
metrics.description: Suspicious activity reports filed in the period

metrics.name: kyc_overdue
metrics.description: Customers past their KYC refresh date

metrics.name: alert_backlog
metrics.description: Open alerts at a point in time

conventions.rule: SAR existence and content are legally confidential; never surface individual SARs or customer identities in analytics.
Alert volumes change when scenarios are tuned; mark tuning dates on trends.

insight_rules.reason: Outlier detection on individual customers is investigation work, not reporting; report at scenario or segment level.

caveats.text: Financial-crime data is typically restricted; responses are aggregated and access-checked.
Scenario tuning, not risk, may explain a volume change.

chart_conventions.rule: Show the alert-to-case-to-SAR funnel as a bar funnel with conversion rates.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
